title: Interview with Mina
summary: Marcus interviewed Mina, an engineer, in a newsroom interview.

qa_highlights.question: How did you pay for the first year?
qa_highlights.answer: A small grant covered the equipment and weekend consulting paid for the rest

qa_highlights.question: What would you tell someone just starting out?
qa_highlights.answer: Write down what you tried even when it fails

qa_highlights.question: What was your biggest early mistake?
qa_highlights.answer: They trusted the vendor numbers without checking them

qa_highlights.question: How did people react when it came out?
qa_highlights.answer: Mostly curiosity, and some critics said the method was too slow

quotes.speaker: Mina
quotes.text: Failed experiments teach you the most.

follow_ups.task: Introduce the interviewer to their former supervisor
